title: Plan audit
description: Agent B's verdict on a draft spec, before any code is written (plans/full-pipeline.md, step 5).

verdict.description: approve: lock it. revise: a fresh ideate fixes the findings. defer: it waits on in-flight work (soft dependency). reject: it should not be built.

summary.description: The verdict's reason in one to three sentences.

overlapAssessment.description: When the harness reports file overlap with open PRs: why building this now is safe, or null to accept the overlap as a reason to defer.

waitsOn.description: defer only: what it waits on, e.g. "#11" or "B02".

designRequest.description: When UI_RULES.md doesn't cover a visual decision the spec needs: the request for the owner (written to design-request.md). Otherwise null.

backlogChangeRequests.description: Backlog fixes for the owner to apply, e.g. "B03 should depend on B02".
